{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA condemns the heaviest Israeli airstrikes in Gaza since 2014.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"At least six people have been killed in the Israeli airstrikes in Gaza.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Scores of buildings, including the TV station Al-Aqsa TV, have been destroyed in the Israeli airstrikes in Gaza.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Israeli attacks are part of an escalation of violence that began when a team of Israeli commandos killed seven Hamas members, including a commander, in a clandestine raid in the southern city of Khan Younis on Sunday.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA mourns the most recent casualties in the ongoing conflict.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA decries the act of unilateral Israeli aggression that triggered the latest round of violence.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Palestinian groups in the Gaza Strip claim they have agreed to an Egyptian-brokered ceasefire with Israel as of this writing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA demands that Israel immediately stop all airstrikes and land incursions into Palestinian territory.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
